text:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: decode-runtime p99 latency spike detected in prod-us-west-2. SLO breach auto-alert. p95=2.3s (goal=0.8s), p99=5.2s (goal=2.0s). Incident INC-3590012345 created and paging oncall.

aya (oncall): Oncall here. Paging rafael, nina, arjun + eng-ml. Any known deploys in last 4h?

rafael (eng-sre): Seeing GPU pagefaults and kernel OOM-like stalls on nodes in pool gpu-rt-5. Faults started ~03:40 UTC. Correlates with compilepath-gamma rollout (v3.0.0) that began ~2.5h ago to ~15% traffic. Paging rate increased ~5x; dmesg shows repeated VA mapping faults.

nina (eng-runtime): We promoted trt8 + flashattn v1.8.0 and toggled a new compiler flag `--prefer-fused-attn` in the compile pipeline for improved throughput. Canary ran earlier today with that flag. The flag selects a fused attention kernel `attn_fused_v3`.

aya (oncall): Mitigation options: pause rollout, route to fallback model (non-TRT), reduce instance concurrency, enable conservative KV eviction, or drain/rollback affected nodes. Let's pause rollout and route 30% to fallback while we triage.

arjun (eng-platform): Pausing rollout now. Command: `deploy-bot pause rollout compilepath-gamma --env prod-us-west-2`

deploy-bot: accepted: pause rollout compilepath-gamma -> in progress

rafael (eng-sre): Quick node probe: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=decode-runtime -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.hostIP}\n' | grep gpu-rt-5
# examine dmesg on node gpu-rt-5-7
ssh admin@gpu-rt-5-7 sudo journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 200 | grep -i pagefault
```
Found repeated pagefaults on gpu-rt-5-2 and gpu-rt-5-7. meminfo shows fragmentation and lower contiguous alloc success.

zoe (eng-ml): Recommend routing to `redwood-decode-compat-v1` (CPU/less aggressive kernel). It preserves output shape/quality for current customers. Suggest 30% traffic shift initially.

aya (oncall): Routing 30% -> redwood-decode-compat-v1 now. `routerctl set-route decode-runtime --variant redwood-decode-compat-v1 --weight 30%`

arjun (eng-platform): Router change applied. 

kim (sre): Support queue trending: 14 tickets mention slow streams and stalled chunks; median stall ~18s, tail > 45s in some cases. Flagging VIP customers for CS outreach.

nina (eng-runtime): Captured a short nvprof / per-kernel trace on affected node. Excerpt: 
```
[2026-06-01T03:42:11Z] kernel_launch: attn_fused_v3 alloc temp_buf size=1.2GiB -> failed partial alloc -> triggering vm page fault and host fallback
GPU0 util=68% page_faults=7 cycles_waiting=120ms
backtrace: decode_step -> attention_dispatch -> attn_fused_v3
```
This fused kernel uses a transient allocation pattern that increases pressure on fragmented GPU memory. On some instance types this leads to page thrash.

rafael (eng-sre): Start staged rollback to compilepath v2.9.8 on affected pool to validate. Plan: rollback batch=50% then monitor for 10m, then continue to 100% if stable. Command: 
```
deploy-bot rollback compilepath --version v2.9.8 --pool gpu-rt-5 --batch 50% --reason "paging regressions"
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated -> target v2.9.8; batch=50%

aya (oncall): Also set runtime guardrails: reduce `max_concurrency` from 16 -> 6 for decode-runtime, and enable `kv_cache.conservative_eviction=true`. Apply temporary non-streaming fallback for large seq (>512) to avoid head-of-line stalls.

nina (eng-runtime): Applying runtime flags now. Commands: 
```
redwoodctl runtime update decode-runtime --set max_concurrency=6 --set kv_cache.conservative_eviction=true --set streaming.large_seq_strategy=non_stream_http
```
Settings applied.

zoe (eng-ml): In local repro with trt8 + attn_fused_v3, sequences > 700 tokens trigger repeated transient allocs and large-page fragmentation. Repro instructions added to RCA ticket.

rafael (eng-sre): After first rollback batch p99 on rolled nodes dropped from ~5.2s -> ~2.4s. Overall prod p99 improved to ~3.0s. Good signal; proceeding to complete rollback.

aya (oncall): I'll notify CS with templated message and escalate to accounts team for customers with SLA alerts. kim, please coordinate.

kim (sre): Will send notification to Tier-1 and Tier-2 lists. Draft note: "We observed degraded decode latency in US-West-2 tied to a recent runtime kernel rollout. Mitigation in progress; routing and rollback underway. We're monitoring and will update in 30m."

nina (eng-runtime): For long-term fix: options are 1) adjust fused kernel allocation to be memory-safe (stream allocations / pre-alloc from memory pool), 2) make fused path optional by default until compatibility validated, or 3) add CI smoke with long-seq streaming on representative instance types. I'll own kernel patching / repro. Opening RCA ticket: RCA-3590012345.

rafael (eng-sre): Rolling remainder: 
```
deploy-bot rollback compilepath --version v2.9.8 --pool gpu-rt-5 --batch 50% --continue
```

deploy-bot: rollback batch accepted -> proceeding to 100%

zoe (eng-ml): Also proposing short-term CI job: run 5m streaming decode on candidate compilepath builds with seq lengths [256,512,1024] to catch alloc regressions.

aya (oncall): Agreed. Added CI task to RCA ticket and assigned to zoe. Action items: finish rollback, monitor paging and p99, prepare postmortem if SLA customers impacted >30m, add CI smoke, and patch kernel or revert `--prefer-fused-attn`.

deploy-bot: rollback complete across pool gpu-rt-5 -> compilepath v2.9.8

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-3590012345 mitigations applied; p99 trending down. Next automated check in 5m.

aya (oncall): Handing off to nina for overnight RCA & monitoring. If paging flares, @rafael is primary. Leaving notes in incident doc.

nina (eng-runtime): Taking over. I'll post nvprof traces and a minimal repro in RCA-3590012345. Please add any extra kernel logs here.

kim (sre): Notified CS/Tier lists. Monitoring support queue.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (provisional): SLOs restored; will keep ticket open for RCA until root cause confirmed and follow-ups complete.
